maintenance.admin_error: An error occurred when updating maintenance state

announce_confirm.title: Announce maintenance?
announce_confirm.description: Every user will see a countdown, then will be redirected to the maintenance page. The server refuses every API call 30s after that.

lock_confirm.title: Lock now?
lock_confirm.description: Every user is redirected to the maintenance page right away. The server refuses every API call 30s after that.

off_confirm.title: End maintenance?
off_confirm.description: Users waiting on the maintenance page will be sent back to Twitchat.
